description: This Java class manages a history of string entries using Android's SharedPreferences for persistence. It provides methods to load, save, add, and retrieve history items, maintaining a maximum size constraint.

classes.name: History
classes.description: A utility class for maintaining a history of strings with persistent storage and size constraints.

methods.name: History
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the history with preferences, key, and maximum size.

methods.name: ensureMaxSize
methods.description: Removes oldest entries to maintain the maximum size limit.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current history items to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new item to history, ensuring no duplicates and respecting size constraints.

methods.name: addAllTo
methods.description: Adds all history items to a given collection in reverse order.
